title: SkullRenderLegionIdentity
description: Office Saep/Sae/spine identity + optional personality pack injection. Canvas SoT: legion-rasci-sdlc v2.3.

stage.description: SDLC stage key when office is saep/sae (scope|arqui|ux|ingenieria|qa|deploy|prod|mejora).

reports_to.description: Parent identity id (Saes → Saep; Saep → Orquestador; Orquestador → Presentador).

handoff_owner.description: True only for Saep (stage) or spine actors that may emit handoff.

rasci_rows.description: Canvas RASCI row ids this identity participates in (e.g. 4.2, 4.13).

personality_pack.description: Pack id to inject when this office runs with voice (e.g. PackLich). Omit for pack-free office runs.

personality_pack_default.description: If true, Orquestador injects personality_pack on kickoff of this office.
